title: v1.0.89 Beta — Advanced Attendance Logging
description: You're on the bleeding edge! This beta release brings advanced session types to attendance logging and fixes the beta opt-in bug.
features:
📋 Detailed Session Types
You can now categorize your logged attendance sessions with specific types: Self Study, Revision, Class, Pending Topic, and Mock Test.

📝 Edit Session Types
Forgot to log the type? You can now edit past study sessions and set their session type retroactively.

🌟 Day Report Badges
Your day report now beautifully displays the session type alongside the Focus badge, giving you instant clarity on how you spent your time.

🛠️ Beta Opt-in Fix
Fixed a major bug where toggling the Beta switch artificially upgraded your version without actually downloading the update, leaving you stuck.
